name: storage-server
description: An easy to setup and optimized storing solution using Bun.
author: M336

scripts.start: bun build --target bun --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax --outfile build.js app.js && NODE_ENV=production bun build.js --smol --max-executable-size=192 --max-old-space-size=256 --max-semi-space-size=2
